objections.objection: Why not invoke native PostgreSQL for every hypothetical design?
objections.wording_action: Retain native as semantic validation oracle and emphasize dependency exposure.

objections.objection: Acquiring hypothetical payloads may dominate design cost.
objections.wording_action: Keep it an explicit offline boundary, not a solved capability.

objections.objection: The workload-scale designs are not globally optimal.
Two workloads are insufficient for broad generality.
objections.wording_action: Frame as complementary replication, not representativeness.

objections.objection: Lower q-error may not improve plan quality or runtime.
Hand-coded semantics may be brittle across PostgreSQL versions and mechanisms.
objections.wording_action: Describe source-informed validation and deny automatic compilation.

objections.objection: Maintenance coefficients are not portable and deployment prediction is imperfect.
Frozen-payload optimization may be invalid after sampling drift.
objections.wording_action: Separate semantic fidelity from realization uncertainty; do not imply ranking stability.

objections.objection: The mixed semantic evaluator is slower than its control, weakening the efficiency claim.
objections.wording_action: Claim semantic-work reduction, not universal runtime speedup.

objections.objection: DMV aggregate loss is pathological because two truths are zero.
objections.wording_action: Preserve raw objective for consistency and mark nonzero-truth loss diagnostic only.

objections.objection: Missing DMV frozen provenance prevents a full deployment comparison.
objections.wording_action: State paired drift unavailable while preserving independently supported fresh claims.

objections.objection: The semantic scope is too narrow to establish a general physical-design method.
objections.wording_action: Make bounded PostgreSQL evidence and architectural abstraction distinct.

strongest_objection_reason: The method assumes a frozen payload repository, and acquiring payloads for a large candidate universe may be a substantial end-to-end systems cost not solved by CE-Replay.
optional_camera_ready_items: Additional global-bound evidence on larger restricted instances.
Optimize the mixed evaluator's numerical aggregation and report an implementation follow-up without changing semantic claims.
